lines.text: Hi, I called earlier and got voicemail. Can I book something for this week?
Sorry we missed you. I'm Donna, the AI assistant for this business. I can book you in right now. What do you need?

faq.q: Will callers know they are talking to an AI?
faq.a: Yes. Donna.AI introduces itself as an AI assistant for your business.

Plans start at $197 a month. Your exact price depends on what your business needs, and our AI specialist puts it together with you on a free 20-minute call. Book before December 31 and setup is included free. Month-to-month, no contracts.
No. Every package is month-to-month. Stay because it books you appointments, not because you signed for a year.

faq.q: What is the free missed-call audit?
faq.a: We call your business line during the day and after hours, the way a new customer would, and show you what happened: answered, voicemail or no answer. It is free and there is no obligation.

faq.q: Do I need a new website or phone system?
faq.a: No. Donna works with the phone number you already have. Calls are forwarded to Donna.AI when you choose, for example after hours or when you are busy. A website is an optional add-on.

faq.q: What happens with calls it cannot handle?
faq.a: It takes a message and passes the caller to you, by text or email, with a summary.
Yes. Hear Donna on our demo line, then test your own Donna on a test line before any customer hears it.

faq.q: Can you build more than a receptionist?
faq.a: Yes. Donna is where most businesses start. We also build custom AI automations, agents and full AI systems, quoted per project after a free scoping call.

calculator.meta_description: Estimate what missed calls cost your business each month, and what answering them could bring back. The math runs in your browser.
calculator.title: What are missed calls
calculator.subtitle: Pick your type of business for example values, then change the four numbers to yours. The math runs in your browser and nothing you type is sent anywhere.
calculator.presets_note: Example values for a small business of that type, to start from. They are not research and not a promise: replace them with your own numbers.

notes.calls_per_week: Example value. Use your own count from your phone bill or call log.
notes.missed_pct: Starting value from industry research: 27% of calls to home services businesses go unanswered (Invoca, 2024), used for home services; 28% of calls to businesses go unanswered (CallRail, 2025), used for the other types. Your audit shows your real number.
notes.job_value: Example value. Use what a new customer is worth to you on average: a job, a visit, a case or a commission.
notes.close_pct: Example value. Of the new callers who reach you, how many become paying customers?
notes.recover_pct: Donna.AI planning assumption, not a measured result: the share of missed callers who would still book if they were answered, or texted back within minutes. Donna.AI has no client data yet.

sources.label: Invoca, How much missed sales calls cost home services businesses (2024-05-23)
CallRail, How missed calls are costing your business (2025-09-11)

calculator.disclaimer: Estimates for planning only. Not every missed call is a new job: some are existing customers, spam, or callers who reach you later. Lower the numbers if that fits your business.
calculator.cta_text: The calculator uses estimates. The free missed-call audit uses your own line: we call it during the day and after hours, the way a new customer would, and show you what happened.
